description: Memory-quality eval for semantic retrieval. Question types follow LoCoMo / LongMemEval: single_hop, multi_hop (needs graph expansion), temporal (newer fact should win), knowledge_update (superseded fact should lose), abstention (nothing relevant -> empty). Pills are keyed; age_days sets updated_at.

pills.title: Docker layer caching
pills.content: Order Dockerfile instructions so dependency installation is cached before copying source code.

pills.title: Local MongoDB runs in Docker Compose
pills.content: The local MongoDB replica set for OpenPill is started with docker compose; data lives in a named volume.

pills.title: Embeddings come from Ollama
pills.content: OpenPill embeds pills locally with Ollama nomic-embed-text through LiteLLM; vectors have 768 dimensions.

pills.title: Changing the embedding model breaks search
pills.content: Switching EMBEDDING_MODEL on existing data mixes vector spaces; re-embed every pill with backfill before switching.

pills.title: Python GIL and CPU-bound threads
pills.content: The GIL serializes CPU-bound threads; use multiprocessing or native extensions for parallel CPU work.

pills.title: Blocking calls stall asyncio
pills.content: A blocking call inside an async handler stalls the event loop; move it to a thread with asyncio.to_thread.

pills.title: Validate LLM JSON with Pydantic
pills.content: Parse model output into a Pydantic schema and reject invalid fields instead of trusting free text.

pills.title: Idempotency keys for retries
pills.content: Consumers must be idempotent: retries with the same idempotency key must not create duplicate side effects.

pills.title: Event-driven consumers need retries and dead-letter queues
pills.content: Event consumers should retry with backoff and move poison messages to a dead-letter queue.

pills.title: Ports and adapters for LLM providers
pills.content: Keep the LLM client behind a port so Gemini, Anthropic or a fake can be swapped without touching graph nodes.

pills.title: Tests run against a fake model
pills.content: The test suite uses a deterministic fake client with no network, so 118 tests run offline.

pills.title: NiCE screening feedback
pills.content: In the NiCE screening they asked about event-driven consumers; I skipped idempotency and retries.

pills.title: Prep plan for the next round
pills.content: Rehearse a walkthrough of message deduplication and backoff with concrete numbers before Monday.

pills.title: Omnora wanted more evals
pills.content: Omnora's interviewers wanted more evaluation of the agent: labeled cases and accuracy numbers.

pills.title: DeepL interview done
pills.content: Finished the DeepL technical interview; no follow-up sent yet.
